title: Parity circuit computes parity
statement: Let $n,r,q$ be natural numbers with $n\le r^{q+2}$. The Boolean function computed by the parity depth circuit built from blocks of size $r$ and parameter $q$ equals the parity function on all $n$ coordinates, whose value at an input is the product of its coordinate signs.
